usages.explain: Because 「V-てあります」describes a state resulting from someone's intentional action, this phrase can be used to say that something has been prepared. In this case, the word 「もう」is often used.

examples.content: 会議の日はもう決めてあります。
examples.transcription: かいぎのひはもうきめてあります。
examples.mean: The date of the meeting has already been decided.

examples.content: 部屋はもう片付けてあります。
examples.transcription: へやはもうかたづけてあります。
examples.mean: The room has already been tidied up.

usages.explain: Note: The verbs used in this pattern are intransitive verbs.

title: もうV-てあります => is/has been done (resulting state)
